subject: general
question: With reference to the literary creations of ancient India, which of the following pairs is correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mudrarakshasa - Vishakhadatta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Vishakhadatta wrote the famous book Mudrarakshasa.
 
• Mudrarakshasa is a historical play in Sanskrit.
 
 
• It tells the ascent of king Chandragupta Maurya to power in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mrichchhakatika** was written by **Shudraka.**

 
 
• It is a** ten-act Sanskrit drama,** an ancient playwright who is possibly from the 5th century CE, and who is identified by the prologue as a Kshatriya.
 
• The main story is about a young man named** Charudatta** of Pataliputra (Patna), and his love for **Vasantasena.**
 
 
 
• **Banabhatta **is the author of **Kadambari.**
 
 
• **​**Kadambari is a romantic novel written in **Sanskrit.**
 
 
 
• **Malavikagnimitram** was written by **Kalidasa.**
 
 
• ​It preserves the memory of the defeat of the Greeks at the hands of **Vasumitra, **the grandson of Pushyamitra Sunga.
 
• Vasumitra defeated the Yavanas (Greeks) on the banks of the Sindhu river.
